content: {"episode_id":"ep-05061","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Cardiac event monitoring was ordered to evaluate intermittent arrhythmias that may contribute to these symptoms and to assess stroke risk."}
